title: HNF4A as a potential target of PFOA and PFOS leading to hepatic steatosis: Integrated molecular docking, molecular dynamic and transcriptomic analyses.
authors: Li, Rui; Zhang, Zijing; Xuan, Yuxin; Wang, Yulu; Zhong, Yuyan; Zhang, Lingyin; Zhang, Jinrui; Chen, Qian; Yu, Shuling; Yuan, Jintao
one_liner_zh: 该文通过分子对接、MD模拟和转录组分析研究PFOA/PFOS与HNF4A（转录因子）的结合及其致肝脂肪变性机制，虽涉及TF-DNA互作靶点但未聚焦结合位点预测或互作界面建模，方法可迁移但深度有限。
abstract: Perfluorooctanoic acid (PFOA) and perfluorooctane sulfonate (PFOS) are indeed among the most well known and extensively studied Per- and polyfluoroalkyl substances (PFASs), and increasing evidence confirm their effects on human health, especially liver steatosis. Nonetheless, the molecular mechanisms of their initiation of hepatic steatosis is still elusive. Therefore, potential targets of PFOA/PFOS must be explored to ameliorate its adverse consequences. This research aims to investigate the molecular mechanisms of PFOA and PFOS-induced liver steatosis, with emphasis on identifying a potential target that links these PFASs to liver steatosis. The potential target that causes PFOA and PFOS-induced liver steatosis have been explored and determined based on molecular docking, molecular dynamics (MD) simulation, and transcriptomics analysis. In silico results show that PFOA/PFOS can form a stable binding conformation with HNF4A, and PFOA/PFOS may interact with HNF4A to affect the downstream conduction mechanism. Transcriptome data from PFOA/PFOS-induced human stem cell spheres showed that HNF4A was inhibited, suggesting that PFOA/PFOS may constrain its function. PFOS mainly down-regulated genes related to cholesterol synthesis while PFOA mainly up-regulated genes related to fatty acid beta-oxidation. This study explored the toxicological mechanism of liver steatosis caused by PFOA/PFOS. These compounds might inhibit and down-regulate HNF4A, which is the molecular initiation events (MIE) that induces liver steatosis.
abstract_zh: 全氟辛酸（PFOA）和全氟辛烷磺酸（PFOS）确实属于最知名且被广泛研究的全氟和多氟烷基物质（PFASs），且越来越多的证据证实它们对人类健康的影响，尤其是肝脏脂肪变性。然而，它们引发肝脏脂肪变性的分子机制仍不明确。因此，必须探索PFOA/PFOS的潜在靶点，以减轻其不良后果。本研究旨在探讨PFOA和PFOS诱导肝脏脂肪变性的分子机制，重点在于识别将这些PFASs与肝脏脂肪变性联系起来的潜在靶点。基于分子对接、分子动力学（molecular dynamics, MD）模拟和转录组学分析，已探索并确定了导致PFOA和PFOS诱导肝脏脂肪变性的潜在靶点。计算机模拟结果显示，PFOA/PFOS能与HNF4A形成稳定的结合构象，且PFOA/PFOS可能通过与HNF4A相互作用影响下游传导机制。来自PFOA/PFOS诱导的人干细胞球的转录组数据显示，HNF4A受到抑制，表明PFOA/PFOS可能限制其功能。PFOS主要下调与胆固醇合成相关的基因，而PFOA主要上调与脂肪酸β-氧化相关的基因。本研究探讨了PFOA/PFOS引起肝脏脂肪变性的毒理学机制。这些化合物可能抑制并下调HNF4A，这是诱导肝脏脂肪变性的分子起始事件（MIE）。
